    About CGTMSE

    Expanding Access to Finance. Strengthening the MSME Ecosystem.

    A Trust established jointly by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India, and the Small Industries Development Bank of India to catalyse the flow of institutional credit to micro and small enterprises.

    Through the Credit Guarantee Scheme, CGTMSE provides guarantee cover for collateral-free and third-party-guarantee-free credit extended by eligible Member Lending Institutions. By sharing credit risk with lenders, the guarantee widens access to finance for new-generation, under-served and first-time borrowers, and strengthens the credit delivery system for the sector as a whole.

    MandateCatalyse institutional credit to micro and small enterprises
    InstrumentCredit guarantees to lenders, not loans to borrowers
    PartnersBanks, NBFCs, RRBs and select financial institutions
    ReachManufacturing and service enterprises across India

    Our framework

    How credit guarantee support works

    Eligible lending institutions provide the loans. CGTMSE provides guarantee cover to those lenders, according to the applicable scheme conditions.

    EntrepreneurEligible micro or small enterprise
    Loan application
    Collateral-free loan
    Member Lending InstitutionBank, NBFC or FI registered with CGTMSE
    Application & fee
    Guarantee cover
    CGTMSEGuarantor to the lender
    1. 1Entrepreneur

      Approaches an eligible lender

      Applies for a term loan or working capital at a registered Member Lending Institution.

    2. 2Lender

      Appraises and sanctions

      Evaluates the business under its own credit process and sanctions the loan.

    3. 3Lender

      Applies for guarantee cover

      After sanction or disbursement, lodges the application with CGTMSE online.

    4. 4CGTMSE

      Issues the guarantee

      Approves the application; cover begins once the applicable fee is received.

    CGTMSE does not grant loans, credit facilities or subsidies, and has no agents for arranging them. Entrepreneurs should approach any Member Lending Institution directly.

    Programmes and initiatives

    Guarantee programmes for every part of the enterprise economy

    Each programme below is administered by CGTMSE and governed by its published scheme document or circular.

    CGS-I · Flagship

    Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises

    Guarantees collateral-free credit extended by banks and financial institutions to new and existing micro and small enterprises in manufacturing and services, including retail and wholesale trade.

    Scheme document
    ₹10 croreGuarantee ceiling per eligible borrower, raised from ₹5 crore (Circular 250/2024-25)Annual Guarantee Fee from 0.37% p.a. Fee structure
    Circular 241

    Women entrepreneurs

    Enhanced extent of guarantee coverage for loans to women-owned enterprises.

    Read circular
    Circular 257/2025-26

    Collateral Support for Export Credit

    Special credit guarantee scheme for MSME exporters under the Export Promotion Mission, applied for through DGFT.

    Read circular
    CGS-II

    Scheme for NBFCs

    Guarantee cover for eligible credit to micro and small enterprises from registered non-banking financial companies.

    Scheme document
    Special provisions

    Special category beneficiaries

    Benefits for SC/ST, transgender and PwD entrepreneurs, ZED-certified units, informal micro enterprises and units in J&K and Ladakh.

    Browse circulars
    CGSCL

    Co-Lending

    Guarantee cover for loans to micro and small enterprises given jointly by banks and NBFCs.

    Scheme document
    CGS-PMS

    PM SVANidhi

    Guarantee cover for working-capital loans and credit cards given to street vendors.

    Scheme document
    Sub-Debt portal

    Subordinate Debt

    Guarantee cover for subordinate debt extended to promoters of stressed micro, small and medium enterprises.

    Sub-Debt portal
    GMS portal

    PM Vishwakarma

    Guarantee support for loans to artisans and craftspeople under the PM Vishwakarma scheme.

    Scheme document

    Economic development

    Supporting the Enterprises That Power India's Economy.

    New and existing micro and small enterprises in manufacturing and services are eligible. Agriculture, Self Help Groups and Joint Liability Groups are outside the scheme.

    Financial inclusion

    The guarantee replaces collateral, opening formal credit to first-generation, under-served and new-to-credit entrepreneurs.

    Important note: CGTMSE does not provide any financial assistance. It only gives guarantees for the collateral / third-party-guarantee-free assistance provided by its Member Lending Institutions, viz. banks, RRBs and select financial institutions. CGTMSE does not have any agents or agencies for arranging loans, credit facilities or subsidies.
